_metadata.source: ACS 2024 5-Year Public Use Microdata Sample (household + person files)
_metadata.definition: Household types from occupied housing units (group quarters excluded). Income: HINCP x ADJINC (2024 dollars), clipped to [0, 600000). eld_dis: any member 60+ or with a disability (DIS=1). kids: any member under 18. earns: WAGP+SEMP > 0. head_citizen: reference person's CIT != 5. earned_share: weighted mean of (WAGP+SEMP)/HINCP clipped to [0,1].
